work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Apostolic letter CLXXXIII grants the rector of the Roman House of Catechumens parochial jurisdiction over its residents, regulating baptism, Easter communion, marriage, viaticum and funerals; intitulation, narrative, grant, decernentes and non obstantibus clauses and dating clause (broken across leaves 250–251) survive. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF34095–34095; the source dating clause at LF34248–34257 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima nona novembris millesimo ANNO MDCCCXLIi. a ® e * octingentesimo quadragesimo secundo, pontifi- catus Nostri anno decimo secundo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
